answer: Look-alike brokers rushed gate C under the north trellis for one shared badge. To open a desk, a clerk must lift pigment cake P-4 from shelf B, walk 41 m to raven desk 2, and press a 15 mm mark on card K-19 before the 08:04 chime. Mass must stay 41 g +/- 2 g, the mark 14-17 mm, and the walk 22-40 s. A 5-cake stake is taken even on a refuse. A thin mark, a reused cake, or a late press seals the shelf for 5 chimes.
